status: DESIGN — Claude level design; source of truth for the Blender blockout. Not live content.
axes: Babylon XZ: +x east, +z north. Blender export maps (x, y, z) -> Babylon (-x, z, -y).
base: planning/levels/rimecrest-v1-base.json (minimal xexoria.level-base.v1: colliding props with radii, POIs and quest objects)
renamed: was 'Frostvale' (frostvale_snow) until 2026-10-02 20:50; renamed to avoid closeness to another game's 'Frostveil Pass'

invariants.traversal: planar XZ moveCapsule on Y=0; relief is visual only and sits outside walkable space
invariants.camera: ArcRotate radius 13 m, beta 1.18 rad, FOV 1.02 rad, target 1.65 m
invariants.no_invisible_walls: every collider sits on a visible blocker: water edge, pressure-ridge slabs, rock, cliff toe, ruin wall, trunk, basalt rim or the barred gate
invariants.frozen_lake: decision: the shore-fast ice shelf (and the hidden causeway + isle) is walkable ground at Y=0; the thin ice and the steaming open lead are a no-go water hazard bounded by pressure-ridge slabs. Why: a calm, telegraph-readable ice field for lv1 that reads as solid; the visible slab line and dark water make the boundary obvious with no invisible wall; no shortcut across the lake skips the loop or its reveals; the open lead (kept open by the warm Steamrun) foreshadows the boss heat; no new server movement features

hazards.source: layout decision 2026-10-02: thin ice and the open lead are no-go water; the pressure ridge is the visible collider on the shelf side, the water edge elsewhere (banks with boulders and frozen reeds)

surfaces.look: snow-dusted white-blue ice with skate scratches and drift tongues; never glossy; telegraphs read on it (mid value 0.70-0.78)

surfaces.surface: causeway and isle, walkable at Y=0
bare wet basalt flagstones with a carved sun-ray inlay; snow-free (geothermal)
surfaces.look: dark wet basalt (value 0.25-0.35) so the gold boss and red boss rings read; cream travertine and warm moss only outside the arena

clearings.role: zone 1 hunting field: snowy shore + the walkable ice shelf (lv1 ticks and raptors)
raptor den under the frozen waterfall
zone 2: pine wood on the ridge terrace (wraiths; raptors at the west seam)
zone 3: temple court and colonnade (golems; wraiths at night)

packed snow trail, darker than the snowfield

paths.surface: packed snow; timber bridge over the Steamrun
paths.note: NE junction -> east shore (past the Rimehold west gate) -> Steamrun Bridge -> camp: closes the loop
the danger route: return road -> west gate -> court -> south gate -> Sunscald Pass -> arena rim; golems guard it
ridge road -> Rimeheart Mouth -> grotto (elite pocket)

paths.surface: packed snow on thick ice between slab lines
paths.note: starts behind a fallen slab on the shelf; dead end at Cairn Isle (hidden reward)

water.note: frozen lake. Walkable: the shore-fast ice shelf (surfaces.glassmere_ice_shelf, Y=0) and the causeway/isle. Not walkable: hazards.glassmere_open_water (thin ice + the steaming open lead kept open by the warm Steamrun)

water.flow: from the steamrun_spring hot pool in the basin, out through the NW breach of the rim, under the bridge, into Glassmere's SE corner
water.note: never freezes; steam wisps; banks drop within 1.2 m
a warm soaking pool by the Steamrun where the herders rest: steam, stone benches, sit emotes; a quiet social spot on the return road

frozen waterfall: a wide 12 m curtain of blue-white columns in three frozen tiers under the 18-26 m cove cliff (the cliff runs out of frame, the curtain stays in it: the frame top is about 12 m at 46 m); translucent at thin edges, cold core #2F7FA6; never glows
frozen cascade on the grotto back wall, framed by the 9.5 m mouth arch from the ridge: the pocket reveal

bridges.style: timber deck on basalt abutments, yak-wool rope rails; steam rises through the planks

relief.note: snowy south frame with pines; visual only beyond the walkable hint

relief.collider: hill toe line; visible slope start

relief.note: pine-topped knoll east of the camp: shelters the camp and hides the Sunscald steam from the arrival and the camp; its east toe merges into the basin's west rim so no squeeze passage opens between them; collider = footprint
rocky headland: hides the Stillfall cove from the south until the road rounds its tip (reveal); a cairn stands on the tip
blue-grey granite cliffs with snow ledges; the Stillfall freezes down their face
faceted ice cone at the foot of the frozen fall; collider = footprint

relief.camera_rule: roofless grotto; for the first 12 m from the floor edge the walls lean back at <= 30 deg up to 7 m (camera-safe apron), then rise vertical; the 13 m boom (camera 6.6 m high, 12 m behind) stays clear except within 0.6 m of the wall; camera collision (D1) handles the rest. The blockout measures boom clearance at 1 m steps

relief.note: barred timber-and-iron gate between the posts: a collider while locked (Lv 20); removed when the warp unlocks
tilted ice slabs piled where the shore-fast shelf meets thin ice; the visible collider of the walkable shelf; it lines the hidden causeway and rings Cairn Isle

low on purpose: the steam reads from the ridge across the lake. The Steamrun leaves through a 10 deg cleft (130-140 deg) narrower than the stream itself, so the stream is never a back door into the arena
tall on purpose: hides the steam from the arrival and the camp
broken in places (gaps < 0.7 m are filled with rubble so nobody squeezes through)
snow-covered scree against the east mountains, flush with the ruin's east wall: no dead-end strip behind the ruin
outer slope of the basin rim between the Sunscald Pass and the east mountains (no walkable pocket south of the ruin)
Steamrun banks drop Y 0 -> -0.35 within 1.2 m of the water edge; warm wet stones, no snow, moss

Thai/English: Glassmere Shore Lv 12-14 (west) / Rimehold Lv 18-20 (north-east); prop rimecrest_signpost_hearth
zone 1 landmark: a wide 12 m frozen curtain under the cove cliff, behind Cairn Point; revealed when the road rounds the headland tip

landmarks.route: hidden_causeway: a 2.6 m packed-snow causeway between pressure-ridge slabs, starting behind a fallen slab at the shelf (−25.5, 44)
landmarks.note: visible from the shelf, the way there is the secret; from the isle every landmark is in view (the overlook)

landmarks.arena_rule: no colliding prop, pool, stream or hazard within 13 m of the centre (arena 12 m + 1 m), measured at collider edges; ground cover inside 12 m is low only (<= 0.35 m: warm moss patches, mineral crust; no glow); the sun-ray inlay is flush; steam inside the arena stays below 20 % opacity under 2 m so telegraphs read
landmarks.boss: Solar Scorpion (4.2 m tall, 3.85 x 3.58 m footprint, body radius 2.4 m): a large six-legged quadruped needs the full 24 m floor
landmarks.entry: one entry from the north (Sunscald Pass, from the Rimehold south gate); the exit portal is the second way out, after the fight
landmarks.lore: a sun-forged guardian sleeps under the basin; its solar core never cooled, so hot springs and geysers melt a round hollow in the snow

warp.activation: interact; active only after the fight: from the Solar Scorpion's death until its next 60 s announcement (at most 15 min); dark and inert while the boss is alive, announced or engaged
warp.layout_check: trigger edge 13.2 m from the arena centre (outside the 12 m arena and the 13 m keep-clear)
warp.note: saves the walk back through the Rimehold ruin

lighting.noon: low winter sun from the SSE at about 24 deg elevation, warm key (#F6C95F tint), blue-violet sky fill, ACES; snow never above 235/255 (#E8EEF2), snow shadows #9FB3D1 / #7E8FB8; the basin floor reads dark and wet so the gold boss pops
lighting.dusk: rose-gold key, long blue shadows across the ice shelf, camp fire and ward braziers (once relit) on
lighting.night: cool moon key, warm camp light, basin steam lit amber from below (VFX, capped), wraith chest ice and eyes cyan (emissive capped below bloom), frozen falls catch moonlight; never pitch dark (darkest large areas >= 0.15 luma)
lighting.fog: light blue aerial haze from 100 m; the lure tower keeps >= 0.15 luma contrast against the sky at 116 m
lighting.weather: snowfall uses the shared client weather slot (15 %, rendered as rain in Sunmeadow): light flakes, visibility >= 80 m; tick rows bloom

budgets_per_64m_cell.tiers: C0 <= 120k tris / 40 draws, C1 <= 60k / 24, C2 <= 40k / 16 (device-tier plan 6.4); phones run the Medium preset (C1 in their own cell)
budgets_per_64m_cell.vegetation: thin instances + impostors (snow variant of the sunmeadow-trees-v4 pines); reeds and moss as thin-instanced clumps
budgets_per_64m_cell.textures: shared atlases: snow/ice terrain layers, rock trim, rime-warden ruin trim, camp trim; <= 4 MiB unique per cell
budgets_per_64m_cell.monsters_in_view: worst case measured on a 2 m grid of walkable points (weather rows included): 11 by day / 13 at night within 25 m, 15 / 17 within 40 m; Sunmeadow v2 (reviewed) measures 11-12 / 20; mobile-mid draws 8 at full detail, the rest at LOD1; the elite fight adds at most 1 golem
budgets_per_64m_cell.vfx: each effect <= 10 draws, <= 250 particles (VFX bar); at most 2 geyser bursts at once; steam plumes are camera-facing cards
